_readme: fal is the only surface CineBraid dispatches to. Its H3 facts are not restated here:
fal-h3-backend.js is the shipped adapter, it carries its own verified record with its
own checked date, and it stays the authority for that path. A second copy of those
numbers in the catalogue would be a second source of truth that drifts.
What this file records is what the CATALOGUE needs: that the surface exists, what
kind of thing it is, and which of its offerings CineBraid can actually reach today.
fal is an aggregator and a host, not a model vendor. Nothing in its schema is
evidence about weights - which is the rule that produced the 4-versus-5-second
duration split and the retired 2,000-character prompt refusal.

surfaceFacts.claim: Delivery is queue-based: submit, then poll for status and result.
A route is of the form vendor/model/task and is adapter configuration, never identity.
The authority for every fal H3 constraint is fal-h3-backend.js, which records its own evidence and checked date.

role.catalogue: Not used as one. fal's model listing was not read as a research source in this phase; Runware's was.
role.execution: The shipped path. MiniMax H3 in four modes and GPT Image 2 dispatch through it today.

imageSurfaceFacts.claim: The text-to-image route carries NO image input. Every mode that sends a reference, including multi-reference, goes through the /edit route.
The /edit route accepts image_urls with a maximum of 16, and an optional mask_url.
quality is auto, low, medium or high, defaulting to high.
output_format is jpeg, png or webp, defaulting to png.
A custom image_size must satisfy four rules: both edges multiples of 16, longest edge at most 3840, ratio at most 3:1, and total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400.
imageSurfaceFacts.note: A RULE, not a legal-value list. It is therefore enforced by the adapter and asserted as no `resolutions` narrowing in the catalogue. Every size OpenAI documents satisfies all four; the pixel floor is what CineBraid's pre-C2b path violated on every 16:9 frame at its default resolution.

imageSurfaceFacts.claim: No seed field exists on either GPT Image 2 route.

notEstablished.claim: Whether fal narrows GPT Image 2's output SIZES.
notEstablished.status: read in C2b. fal imposes a dimension RULE rather than a list, and every documented OpenAI size satisfies it.
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: The gpt-image-2 offering still carries an empty `constraints` block, because a rule is not a legal-value grid and encoding one as the other would either forbid legal sizes or permit illegal ones. The rule lives in fal-image-backend.js, which carries its own checked date and refuses by name.

notEstablished.claim: Which other catalogued models fal serves.
notEstablished.status: partially investigated. C2b established Seedance 2.5 on three fal routes; the rest of the catalogue was not re-checked.
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: A model absent from this surface is still not a claim that fal lacks it. Seedance 2.5 is now recorded as an offering and stays `catalogued`: fal serving it and CineBraid being able to send to it are different facts, and only the first is established.

notEstablished.claim: fal's per-modality split of Seedance 2.5's 50-reference total.
notEstablished.status: fal documents the combined ceiling only
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: The offering records maxTotal and no split. Runware's 30/10/10 belongs to Runware.

conflicts.resolution: Unchanged from C1.1. The model keeps 4, the surface keeps 5, the intersection is 5, and a paid submission REFUSES rather than converting a 4-second shot into a 5-second one.
